messages:
Ava: quick post-allhands thread — thanks for the great Q&A today. wanted to surface a short synthesis of customer signals (wins vs losses) and ask for owners on follow-ups. TL;DR: reliability + predictable cost = most wins; onboarding + edge-case quality = most losses.
Sam: can you share concrete examples? helps sales when we can cite specifics.
Ava: sure — two quick anonymized notes: 1) Win: fintech startup chose us for Dedicated because we guaranteed <100ms p99 for single-turn inference and provided private networking. 2) Loss: marketplace company chose competitor because their onboarding SDK had a ready-made connector for their workflow and our docs were too terse for their SREs.
Priya: noted — that onboarding connector request is the repeated ask from three demos this quarter. can product prioritize a connector template + sample app?
Marco: will add a starter repo (react + server) for common connectors. ETA: 2w.
Juniper: CS flagged two tickets where customers wanted model pinning by session + simpler rollback UI during canaries. both affected trust during early rollout.
Ava: perfect — those map to our roadmap items but we need clarity on timing. Priya, can we move model-pinning higher? customers are asking for it as a must-have.
Priya: we can reprioritize the rollout UI (canary/rollback) to the next sprint and scope a minimal model-pinning API first (session pinning + simple TTL). estimate: 3 wks for MVP.
Liz: from support — recurring theme: customers ask for per-token cost breakdown in the Console export (csv) per request. helps their finance teams.
Sam: also ask: more sample prompts for regulated industries (PII handling + audit playground). they want to see how we integrate KMS auditing.
Ava: action items: 1) Marco -> starter connector repo (react/server) — due 2025-12-05. 2) Priya -> model-pinning MVP + canary UX shuffle — due 2025-12-12. 3) Liz -> add per-token cost csv export spec, sync w/ billing — due 2025-12-08. 4) Juniper -> collect 3 customer POCs who lost to competitor and gather exact friction points — due 2025-12-01. please ack when you pick up. :white_check_mark:
Marco: ack — will open repo and a short howto doc.
Priya: ack — prioritizing the MVP, will post a design doc in #product by EOD tomorrow.
Liz: ack — looping in billing.
Juniper: ack — will post anonymized notes into this thread.
Sam: one more ask from sales: can we publish a short competitive playbook (1-pager) summarizing why customers pick us vs typical alternatives (cost patterns, SLA, private deploys)? that would help close deals.
Ava: yes — marketing + sales can own that. Sam, can you draft the 1-pager with two exemplar win/loss stories? I can review.
Sam: yes — will draft and share by 2025-12-04.
ops-bot: reminder: Quarterly roadmap review meeting scheduled 2025-12-09 10:00 AM PST — added to #all-hands calendar.
Priya: also flagging a small policy ask — we should surface fallback model behaviors in the Console (which model was used when fallback occurred). customers worry about silent downgrades.
Ava: good point. add that to model-pinning thread and roadmap notes.
Marco: small note — connector starter repo will include an example of handling model fallbacks + logging best practices.
Liz: from support backlog: two customers specifically asked for improved onboarding checklists for Dedicated installs (networking playbook + common firewall rules). I can draft a checklist template.
Ava: brilliant — Juniper and Liz to collaborate on that template and link it to the starter repo.
Sam: thanks — this is actionable and much better than vague feedback. makes sales motion easier.
Ava: final ask — when you post follow-ups, please tag #all-hands and reference this thread_ts so we can synthesize before next leadership sync. love the momentum. :sparkles:
